Chapter one
3 of 20 ideas
  1. Month 1
    EPF

    A slice of every salary goes into a retirement fund before you see it. Your employer adds the same amount again. You cannot touch it easily, which is the point.

  2. Month 2
    Pay yourself first

    Money moved out on the day you are paid gets saved. Money left to save at the end of the month does not. Same salary, different result.

  3. Month 3
    Insurance is not investment

    A product that promises both usually does neither well. Cover protects the people who depend on you. Investment grows money. Products that mix them tend to charge for the mixing.
